message: No detected input validation: The code reads files and processes features without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only (via glob/os.path); no remote sources, checksums, or integrity verification are present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation functions load and transform features without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: Models are loaded directly via tf.keras.models.load_model() and pickle load() from file paths with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous label distributions before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test dataset is loaded via prepare_test_data, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no strict isolation mechanism enforced in code, and no multiple independent metric reporting to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads and processes files directly without any shape checks, range validation, schema enforcement, or malformed-input rejection before passing data to the models.

No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions are collected and aggregated (e.g., accuracy scoring) without any NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on the raw model outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses audio/tabular ML models (MFCCs, compare features, transcription-based features), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
